text:
Samir: FYI inbound ticket from a Dedicated customer reporting high 429s and timeouts for a single tenant. They say it started ~09:20 UTC and is ongoing.
Samir: Key bits from customer: 'sustained 429s, requests that used to be 50-100ms now 500-2k ms, errors started after recent quota change via console'.
Maria: can you paste the tenant id and pool?
Samir: tenant_id=acme-marketing, pool=dedi-west-2-g1, customer-sent logs: `429: rate_limit_exceeded` with body {"quota":"tenant_qps","limit":50,"window":60}
Zach: pinging oncall, I'll pull metrics. @Maria can you check the quota service config for that tenant?
Maria: grabbing from config service...
Maria: found override: `tenant_rate_limits.acme-marketing = 50` — that looks wrong, should be 500 per our onboarding template.
SRE-Bot: alert: dedicated-pool-dedi-west-2-g1 latency spike at 2026-03-15T09:18Z, 95th=1.9s, 429s spiked to 12% for tenant acme-marketing.
Zach: do we have any noisy neighbor evidence? CPU/GPU/util shows ~70% overall and single worker processes for that tenant peaking. But autoscale didn't add nodes.
Samir: customer says they had a quota bump approved last week but maybe the UI change didn't persist.
Maria: checking audit log for config change... here's entry: `2026-03-15T08:58Z user=ops-ui changed tenant_rate_limits.acme-marketing from 500 -> 50` (ops-ui).
Zach: that explains it. Ops UI rollback bug could have applied an old template.
Maria: quick repro commands for others: `curl -X GET "$CONFIG_SVC/tenants/acme-marketing/rate_limits"` returns `{"qps":50,"burst":100}`
Maria: DB query to confirm: `select tenant_id, qps from tenant_quotas where tenant_id='acme-marketing';` -> `acme-marketing | 50`
Samir: customer is asking ETA to restore.
Zach: propose hotfix: update DB to 500, reload config on pool, then scale revert check. Steps: 1) set DB `update tenant_quotas set qps=500 where tenant_id='acme-marketing';` 2) POST reload to config-svc `curl -X POST $CONFIG_SVC/reload` 3) confirm metrics and clear 429s.
Maria: I'll run step 1 in 2 mins, will be careful to whitelist.
Maria: running: `BEGIN; update tenant_quotas set qps=500 where tenant_id='acme-marketing'; COMMIT;`
Maria: posted reload: `200 OK`
SRE-Bot: config-svc reload triggered by Maria at 2026-03-15T09:28Z
Zach: watching metrics... 429s dropping to 0.8% after 90s. latency 95th down to 220ms.
Samir: customer confirms success, they report traffic normalized. :thumbsup:
Maria: root cause: ops-ui bug persisted an old template when saving tenant overrides (missing merge step). Created ticket: UI-2905.
Zach: follow-ups: (1) rollback fix in UI, (2) add a config change sanity check before writing < lower bound thresholds, (3) run a one-off migration to detect tenants with qps < onboarding min and alert.
Samir: assigning follow-up to infra and product. I'll file the support case note and notify the account owner.
Maria: note for postmortem: include reproduction steps, DB query, and exact audit log snippet.
SRE-Bot: incident closed: short-lived quota-misapply impacting single tenant; severity=P1->P3 after fix.
Samir: thanks team. I'll update the customer thread and close the ticket.
